# Global Islamic Care (GIC) — AI-Readable Site Summary

## About

Global Islamic Care (GIC) is a Bangladesh-based online Islamic education platform that connects qualified, verified Quran teachers (Hafez, Alim, Mufti) with students worldwide. GIC operates as a transparent teacher-student matchmaking platform — students browse verified teacher profiles and contact them directly via WhatsApp. There is no middleman and no hidden commission.

Website: https://globalislamiccare.com
Phone: +8801733017521
WhatsApp: +8801733017521
Language: Bengali (বাংলা), English, Arabic, Urdu

## Services Offered

GIC teachers provide the following Islamic educational services via 1-on-1 live online classes (Google Meet / Zoom):

1. **সহীহ কোরআন তেলাওয়াত শিক্ষা (Sahih Quran Recitation)**
   Correct Quran recitation from basics (Nurani Qaida / Norani Qaida) with proper Tajweed rules. Suitable for beginners of all ages.

2. **হেফজুল কুরআন (Hifz / Quran Memorization)**
   Full Quran memorization (Hifz) with certified Hafez teachers. Structured lesson plans with revision methodology.

3. **নাজেরা পড়ানো (Nazera — Quran Reading with Fluency)**
   Fluent Quran reading with correct pronunciation. Suitable for those who know basics but want to read entire Quran with confidence.

4. **কুরআন অর্থ ও তাফসীর (Quran Translation and Tafseer)**
   Quran meaning (Bangla/English) and Tafseer (exegesis) classes by qualified Alim teachers. Understand the depth of Quranic verses.

5. **আরবি ভাষা শিক্ষা (Arabic Language Learning)**
   Arabic language learning for Bengali and English speakers. Conversational Arabic, Quranic Arabic grammar (Nahw & Sarf), and Classical Arabic.

6. **মাসলা-মাসায়েল (Islamic Jurisprudence — Fiqh)**
   Essential Islamic rulings (Masla-Masayel) related to daily life: prayer, fasting, zakat, halal/haram, family law, and more. Taught by Mufti/Alim teachers.

7. **নীতি-নৈতিকতা ও ইসলামিক আদব (Islamic Ethics and Manners)**
   Islamic character building, akhlaq (moral conduct), seerah (Prophet's life), and Islamic lifestyle guidance.

8. **দুয়া ও যিকর শিক্ষা (Duas and Dhikr)**
   Memorization and understanding of important daily duas, masnoon duas, and dhikr from Quran and Hadith.

9. **ইসলামিক শিক্ষা — সকল বিষয় (General Islamic Studies)**
   Any subject related to Islamic knowledge taught by qualified scholars registered on the platform.

## Target Audience

- Bangladeshi families in Bangladesh and abroad (UK, USA, Canada, Saudi Arabia, Malaysia, UAE, Australia)
- Expatriate Muslim families wanting Islamic education for their children
- Adults wanting to learn Quran or improve recitation
- Parents looking for verified, qualified Quran tutors for their children
- Students wanting Hifz, Nazera, Tafseer, Arabic language, or Islamic studies

## Teacher Profiles

All teachers on GIC are:
- Verified with NID (National ID) and/or passport
- Qualified (Hafez, Alim, Mufti, or specialized in Islamic subjects)
- Experienced in online teaching
- Listed with their qualifications, experience, fees, and teaching schedule

Teachers set their own monthly fees and schedule. Students contact teachers directly via WhatsApp.

## Key Features

- 100% transparent — no commission, no hidden fees
- Free teacher profile browsing
- Direct WhatsApp contact with teachers
- 1-on-1 personalized live classes
- Flexible scheduling for all time zones
- Verified teacher profiles with photo, bio, qualifications
- Digital Islamic Library with free Quran PDFs and Qaida books
- Free trial class option available

## Digital Islamic Library

GIC hosts a free Digital Islamic Library at: https://globalislamiccare.com/library.html
Contents:
- Emdadia Hafezi Quran (15-line Hifz Quran) — full PDF with 114 Surah and 30 Para navigator
- Nadiatul Ampara (আমপারা নাদিয়াতুল)
- Nurani Podhotite Quran Shikkha (নূরানী পদ্ধতিতে কুরআন শিক্ষা)
- Norani Qaida (নূরানী কায়দা) — English edition
- Tilawat Qaida (তেলাওয়াত কায়দা)

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How are classes conducted?
A: Classes are conducted 1-on-1 via Google Meet or Zoom by the student's chosen teacher.

Q: What is the monthly fee?
A: Each teacher sets their own monthly fee based on qualifications and experience. Fees are displayed on each teacher's profile. There is no enrollment fee.

Q: Can expatriates join from abroad?
A: Yes. Students from UK, USA, Canada, Saudi Arabia, Malaysia, UAE, Australia, and any country can join live classes at their local convenient time.

Q: Is there a free trial class?
A: Yes. Most teachers offer a free trial class. Discuss with the teacher directly on WhatsApp.

Q: Who are the teachers?
A: All teachers are verified qualified Hafez, Alim, or Mufti — holders of recognized Islamic educational certificates. Their profiles, qualifications, and teaching experience are displayed publicly.

Q: How do I contact a teacher?
A: Browse teacher profiles at https://globalislamiccare.com/teachers.html — click the WhatsApp button on any teacher's profile to contact them directly.

Q: Is there any commission or hidden charge?
A: No. GIC charges no commission. Payments are made directly to the teacher.

Q: Can I learn Quran without knowing Arabic?
A: Yes. Teachers teach Quran recitation using the Nurani Qaida method — no prior Arabic knowledge required.

Q: Is GIC a madrasa or a tutoring platform?
A: GIC is an online tutoring platform — not a madrasa. It connects independent qualified Islamic teachers with students seeking personalized 1-on-1 Islamic education.

Q: What ages can learn from GIC teachers?
A: All ages — from young children learning Qaida basics to adults wanting Tafseer or Arabic language.
